outageMode.behavior: On primary store outage, ResilientRateLimitStore serves per-instance MemoryRateLimitStore. /health reports rate_limit_store.state=degraded with memory_fallback=true and outage_policy=fail-degraded. Never state=ok on memory. /health HTTP stays 200 (liveness). /health/ready does not treat rate_limit_store as critical.
outageMode.whyNotFailClosed: Fail-closed would 503 the public MCP gate on a Neon blip and take Layer-1 free agents offline.
outageMode.silentFallbackForbidden: The memory fallback remains only as this explicitly-surfaced degraded mode. A health body that reports ok while serving memory is the defect class this program hunts.
